title: fix(metadata-admin): drop the SkillPreview Required Permissions panel (framework#3686)
body:
Companion to objectstack-ai/objectstack `feat/prune-skill-permissions`.

Upstream removed `SkillSchema.permissions`: skill invocation was **never** gated by it (the cloud `SkillRegistry` selects on `active` / `triggerConditions` / `tools`). This preview was in fact the *evidence* that got the property mis-marked `live` in the liveness ledger — an authoring-side echo counted as runtime consumption.

Removes the `N required perms` header pill, the "Required Permissions" section and the now-orphan `ShieldCheck` import, leaving a comment that points at the surfaces where access **is** enforced: agent-level `access`/`permissions` (403 at the chat route), or the underlying actions the skill's tools call.

`@object-ui/app-shell` builds green.
